name: Oil (Brent)
summary: Brent near $108.5 after a 3% fall on 2 Nov; Hormuz still largely shut
state: Brent fell about 3% early on 2 Nov to near $108.5 as Iranian negotiators in Qatar discussed a plan that could reopen the Strait of Hormuz within two days (AP); it is up 8% on the month and stays at Alert under the board's hysteresis rule. Iran said on 2 Nov that the strait stays shut until the US lifts its naval blockade.
for_you: Expect continued high petrol, diesel and heating-oil prices, with knock-on effects on transport costs and inflation.
rubric_hit: Brent $108.5 just under $110 Alert line, held by hysteresis; Hormuz largely shut

sources.title: AP — Global shares mixed and US futures advance, while oil prices fall
ANI — Iran demands end to US naval blockade before any agreement on Strait of Hormuz

why: Oil feeds inflation, transport and household budgets; price spikes have preceded most post-war recessions.
drivers: OPEC+ output, Middle East supply risk, sanctions, demand, inventories, shipping disruption.

rubric.alert: Brent > $110, or 1-month change > +30%, or a major physical supply outage (> 2 mb/d).
